description: This file implements a client for managing stateful processing in Spark Structured Streaming, including handling state, timers, and schema serialization/deserialization, with communication over protobuf messages via sockets.

classes.name: StatefulProcessorHandleState
classes.description: Enumeration representing various states of the processor handle, such as PRE_INIT, CREATED, INITIALIZED, DATA_PROCESSED, TIMER_PROCESSED, and CLOSED.

classes.name: StatefulProcessorApiClient
classes.description: Client class for managing state, timers, and schema serialization/deserialization in Spark Structured Streaming via protobuf messages over sockets.

classes.name: ListTimerIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing list timer rows managed by the API client.

classes.name: ExpiredTimerIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing expiry timers managed by the API client.

methods.name: set_handle_state
methods.description: Sets the current handle state in the protobuf message and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: set_implicit_key
methods.description: Serializes and sets an implicit key for the stateful processing.

methods.name: remove_implicit_key
methods.description: Removes the implicit key from the stateful processing context.

methods.name: get_value_state
methods.description: Retrieves a value state by name and schema, with optional TTL.

methods.name: get_list_state
methods.description: Retrieves a list state by name and schema, with optional TTL.

methods.name: register_timer
methods.description: Registers a timer with a specified expiry timestamp.

methods.name: delete_timer
methods.description: Deletes a timer with a specified expiry timestamp.

methods.name: get_list_timer_row
methods.description: Fetches the next list timer row for a given iterator ID.

methods.name: get_expiry_timers_iterator
methods.description: Fetches the next expiry timer row for a given iterator ID and expiry timestamp.

methods.name: get_timestamps
methods.description: Retrieves batch and watermark timestamps based on the specified time mode.

methods.name: get_map_state
methods.description: Retrieves a map state by name with specified key and value schemas and optional TTL.

methods.name: delete_if_exists
methods.description: Deletes a state if it exists, by name.

methods.name: _get_batch_timestamp
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve the current batch timestamp from the JVM.

methods.name: _get_watermark_timestamp
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve the current watermark timestamp from the JVM.

methods.name: _send_proto_message
methods.description: Sends a protobuf message over the socket, prefixing with version and length.

methods.name: _receive_proto_message
methods.description: Receives a protobuf message from the socket.

methods.name: _receive_proto_message_with_long_value
methods.description: Receives a protobuf message with a long value from the socket.

methods.name: _receive_proto_message_with_string_value
methods.description: Receives a protobuf message with a string value from the socket.

methods.name: _receive_proto_message_with_list_get
methods.description: Receives a protobuf message with a list of values.

methods.name: _receive_proto_message_with_map_keys_values
methods.description: Receives a protobuf message with map keys or values.

methods.name: _receive_proto_message_with_map_pairs
methods.description: Receives a protobuf message with map key-value pairs.

methods.name: _receive_proto_message_with_timers
methods.description: Receives a protobuf message with timer information.

methods.name: _serialize_to_bytes
methods.description: Serializes data according to a schema into bytes, normalizing types as needed.

methods.name: _deserialize_from_bytes
methods.description: Deserializes bytes into Python objects.

methods.name: _send_arrow_state
methods.description: Sends state data as an Arrow record batch over the socket.

methods.name: _read_arrow_state
methods.description: Reads state data as an Arrow record batch from the socket.

methods.name: _send_list_state
methods.description: Sends a list of state data over the socket.

methods.name: _read_list_state
methods.description: Reads a list of state data from the socket.

methods.name: _parse_string_schema
methods.description: Parses a schema string into a StructType by calling JVM side.
